scope: Post-completion descriptive pooling of prespecified output-r bins; no added prediction or scoring threshold.
recomputation_source: All six original frozen-run records.jsonl.gz; independent per-image reaggregation. Formal frequency.csv SHA256 was also verified.
weighting: Equal image weight within each dataset; equal mean of 3 fixed models and 2 fixed seeds.
bootstrap: 10,000 within-dataset paired image resamples with frozen seeds; percentile 95% intervals, no multiplicity correction for descriptive intervals.
definition: r=max(abs(f_x),abs(f_y)), cycles per output pixel, FFT after fixed shave 4. J shares use total spatial RGB J including all frequencies as denominator; signed D contributions sum to total D.
